locations.note: November 1974: Big Boss and Kaz Miller run their mercenary unit MSF from the Colombian coast when a Costa Rican professor and a student ask for help.
MSF takes over an offshore platform as its home base, where Snake builds up the army he recruits in the field.
Snake fights through Costa Rica's jungle, cloud forest and coast against the armed force deployed there, and uncovers the nuclear launch platform Peace Walker.
Snake climbs to the crater of Irazú, where the enemy has hidden a base and one of the AI weapons.
Snake chases Peace Walker over the Nicaraguan border to an American airbase on the shores of Lake Cocibolca, held by the Soviets.

routes.name: Big Boss
routes.note: From MSF's camp on the Colombian coast to Mother Base, then through Costa Rica's jungles and Irazú's crater to Lake Nicaragua in pursuit of Peace Walker.
